args:
set -eu
PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PGHOST -U $PGUSER -d $PGDATABASE -Atc "
  select 'parse_event_count=' || count(*)
  from audit.lineage_event
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and lineage_ref like 'parse:%';

  select concat_ws('|',
    lineage_ref,
    source_ref,
    event_payload->>'terminalState',
    event_payload->'metadata'->'loadError'->>'code',
    left(coalesce(event_payload->'metadata'->'loadError'->>'message',''), 220),
    coalesce(event_payload->>'sourceUri','')
  )
  from audit.lineage_event
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and lineage_ref like 'parse:%'
  order by lineage_ref
  limit 10;

  select concat_ws('|',
    s.source_ref,
    s.source_name,
    s.source_uri,
    v.landed_uri,
    s.metadata->>'relativePath',
    s.metadata->>'contentType'
  )
  from source_registry.source s
  join source_registry.source_version v
    on v.tenant_key=s.tenant_key and v.source_ref=s.source_ref
  where s.tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and s.source_visibility='client_visible'
  order by s.source_ref
  limit 10;
"
containers.name: airdn-job
